summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing only to manage the gap over the final two races after his dominant campaign at Mercedes. Lewis Hamilton and George Russell collide in the constructors' battle as Ferrari hunts Mercedes' 142-point advantage, with every position and pit-wall strategy call potentially decisive in the team standings. A win here would move Antonelli within touching distance of the drivers' title with one race remaining in Abu Dhabi.
